chapter: British revival and the Crane River band
title: Forming the Crane River Jazz Band; New York jazz heard at sea
summary: Colyer learned trumpet in the merchant navy and formed the Crane River band c. 1948-49; he recalls hearing the Condon band in New York and first playing at Cranford.
